character.description: Pixel Wave Stage 1 large connected foreground coral-rock formations

tower_reef.action: two distinct single-piece foreground reef formations, one complete connected rock mass per slot; frame 1 is a broad naturally terraced formation about 80 to 90 logical pixels tall, frame 2 is a much larger asymmetric landmark about 105 to 118 logical pixels tall; each formation must be one continuous geological silhouette from wide solid base to irregular crown, not stacked rocks and not separate patches; dark indigo rock with coral growth integrated into ledges; the entire underside is solid and wide enough to overlap the continuous seabed

style: authentic native-resolution hard-edged pixel art matching the accepted Pixel Wave reef base exactly: the same countable logical pixel size as existing 96x64 reef patches, deliberate stair-step curves, broad connected color clusters, limited indigo-blue rock with restrained peach and lavender coral accents, binary edges, no antialiasing, no gradients, no detached debris
